clips.title: The story
paras: At Auberdine's inn, Laird sells fish and cooking supplies to travelers along Darkshore's coast.

Laird sells fish and supplies inside Auberdine's inn. Sailors, locals, and travelers come to him while Darkshore's waters churn with dangers greater than those along Teldrassil's sheltered shores. For anglers willing to cast from the misty beaches, the local catch can bring a handsome profit.

Laird stays in touch with fishing operations across the channel in Teldrassil. Shipments come from his fellow fisher Nessa Shadowsong, linking Rut'theran Village with the mainland port and keeping coastal trade moving.
